process.title: Six clear steps from brief to handover.

briefing.title: 01 · Brief and objectives
briefing.text: We establish the requirements, available information, budget parameters, timeline and expected outcomes. Scope, approvals and communication are agreed.

planning.title: 03 · Technical detailing

production.title: 04 · Work preparation
production.text: Material and quantity schedules, plus partner-specific documents, support procurement and production. Manufacturing is carried out by appointed specialist companies.

onsite.title: 06 · Approval and handover

about.name: Christof Laufersweiler
about.role: Exhibition design, technical planning and project coordination from Leipzig
about.text: I’m Christof Laufersweiler. For more than 20 years, I have worked across exhibition and event projects, from technical drafting and project management to serving as an employed managing director of an exhibition stand company. My training in wood technology and IHK qualification in exhibition and event project management combine practical technical knowledge with experience coordinating complex projects. Through CL Projektwerk I personally support stand builders, agencies and exhibitors with design, planning and coordination.
about.close: My aim: convincing design, precise documents and straightforward collaboration.
about.photoAlt: Portrait of Christof Laufersweiler, founder of CL Projektwerk
about.projectsNote: The projects shown here were undertaken during my previous employment. They are not commissions delivered by CL Projektwerk, and the companies named are not clients of CL Projektwerk.

seo.title: Exhibition design and technical planning, working together.
seo.intro: Based in Leipzig, CL Projektwerk combines creative exhibition concepts with structured technical development. I support stand builders, agencies and exhibitors with 3D visualisation, production drawings, work preparation and project coordination. Services are tailored to each assignment.

blocks.title: Technical planning and production drawings
blocks.text: Clear drawings, component schedules and coordinated interfaces support a smoother manufacturing preparation process.

blocks.title: Work preparation for exhibition projects
blocks.text: Material and quantity schedules, plus production documentation, give project partners a more transparent basis for delivery.

blocks.title: External project coordination
blocks.text: Support with timelines, quotations, trade coordination and documented project decisions.

blocks.title: Concepts, visuals and reuse
blocks.text: Spatial design, presentation artwork and adaptation of existing components complement the technical planning.

faq.a: Fees depend on the task, agreed deliverables and timeline. Following a brief, you receive a tailored proposal for a specific assignment or longer-term support.

faq.q: When should I get in touch?
faq.a: Contact me as soon as the objectives, timeline and initial details are known. I also review urgent requests against current availability.

faq.q: Can I book just a single service?
faq.a: Yes. Concept design, 3D visualisation, technical drawings, work preparation and project coordination can be commissioned individually.

faq.q: Do you also manufacture and assemble?
faq.a: CL Projektwerk provides design, planning and coordination services. Manufacturing, installation and regulated engineering work are handled by qualified specialist contractors. Responsibilities are agreed per project.

faq.q: Are on-site meetings or travel possible?
faq.a: Yes, by prior arrangement. Most planning work is carried out from Leipzig.

faq.q: Can I use a gallery concept as a starting point?
faq.a: Yes. Save your favourites and include them with your enquiry. Concepts are for inspiration and can be adapted to your brief; technical feasibility must be assessed before construction.
